svg.title: BitCareer
svg.desc: BitCareer: AI-powered learning & career-readiness platform for developers. Resume + GitHub → a personalised roadmap. Python & SQL sandbox in isolated Docker containers. Voice-enabled AI mock interviews with reports. Gamified ranks, from Fresher to Legend. Built with React, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, Gemini.
